review_notes: I read the whole file. It has two iff theorems, `isRegularLocalRing_iff_isField` and `isRegularRing_iff_isReduced`. Neither carries `@[simp]`. I grepped the formal-frontier sources for uses. Every use is an explicit `.mp` or `.mpr` application in the tests and in the second theorem's own proof. No `simp` call depends on either theorem.
